# Simulation results summary (auto-generated)

Generated by `scripts/make_report.py` from stored campaign CSV files. All quantities are SIMULATED; energy is MODELED from uncalibrated simulation-assumption power states (`config/power_model.json`, `calibrated: false`). No value here is a physical measurement.

## Key observations (main campaign)

Matched design: 8 scenarios x 6 modes x 10 seeds; every mode of a (scenario, seed) replayed the identical workload file.

* In secure mode the always-on M4 accounts for 83.9% of modeled energy (pooled mean), so the modeled saving is dominated by the assumed M4 monitoring power, not by M7 duty cycle. See `aggregate/energy_model_sensitivity.csv` for how the saving changes when that assumption is scaled.

### Paired statistics

392 paired Wilcoxon signed-rank comparisons; 257 had at least 6 non-zero paired differences and were tested. With Holm correction inside each (scenario, metric) family, 236 are significant at alpha = 0.05. With a single campaign-wide Holm correction, 0 are significant: with 10 seeds the smallest exact two-sided p-value is 0.00195, so a correction over hundreds of tests cannot reject by construction (see docs/EXPERIMENT_PROTOCOL.md). Full table: `aggregate/paired_comparisons.csv`.
